'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a young Roya man who almost became an Outcast, not knowing the severity of the crimes they commit. 

He can be found being scolded by former Outcast, '''Quinones''' at a camp near Etching Plains Resonance Beacon. 

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}} 
:'''Kastelton:''' I didn't know the Outcasts would do something that awful... If I'd known sooner, I—
:'''Quinones:''' Well, what were you expecting?
:'''Kastelton:''' I just wanted to see what the world outside Lahai-Roi looks like. I even tried applying for Startorch Academy, which turned out to be nothing...
:'''Kastelton:''' My mind went blank and I... stole my sister's staff, thinking I could prove myself and join those Outcasts who all look so free.
:'''Kastelton:''' But I never thought they'd actually go rob people... or even try to hurt the Exoswarm!
:'''Quinones:''' You really are an idiot, you know that? Stealing from your own family to prove what, exactly? Go home. And don't ever come back.
:'''Quinones:''' We're not the ones you think that can get you out of Lahai-Roi. And the Outcasts sure aren't either. I suggest you go home before they come after your Exoswarm.
{{Dialogue End}}
